scope: US CRSP transfer of the released LiMT model; not the original Chinese benchmark
universe: Daily 500 largest US-incorporated corporate common stocks by known signal-close capitalization, one PERMNO per PERMCO; NYSE/AMEX/NASDAQ, active regular-way, observed trade close >=5 USD, positive volume, not already delisted. No future-return or current-survivor filter.
features: Qlib Alpha158 with CRSP split-adjusted OHLC, raw share volume, and an explicitly substituted OHLC4 price for VWAP; training-member median/MAD normalization, clip[-3,3], within-window ffill then observed-window mean then zero
vwap_substitution: CRSP daily lacks true VWAP. (open+high+low+close)/4 is a price proxy, never called observed VWAP. dlyprcvol is close times volume and is not treated as VWAP.
return_label: CRSP dlyretx on session t+2, with signal at t and assumed execution at t+1 close
auxiliary_labels: Paper volume shock using raw shares and t+2 high-low range divided by the OHLC4 proxy; targets standardized cross-sectionally within training dates

training.selection: validation mean daily return IC only
training.precision: FP32 parameters/activations, CUDA TF32 matmul enabled; no mixed precision
training.batch: one complete cross-section per step; dates shuffled deterministically each epoch

portfolio.primary: Equal-weight top/bottom deciles, target +50%/-50% of NAV, zero costs, daily rebalance at t+1 close, P&L CRSP total returns t+2; tradeability checked at execution without filtering on t+2 returns
portfolio.secondary: LiMT APO r=0.1 with USD1bn each side, 2% signal-day target caps and execution-day trade caps, larger desired leg scaled down to equal dollars; unallocated capital earns zero
portfolio.cost_sensitivity: 5 bp on positive signed trades (long buys and short covers); sells free; no borrowing/financing/slippage or impact
portfolio.missing_payoffs: Preserve missing held returns as a limitation, zero in primary accounting; report number/weight and adverse +/-100% stress without outcome-based universe deletion
portfolio.terminal: CRSP supplied total return includes terminal outcomes; after a flagged terminal observation convert that security position to cash without adding a second legacy delisting return
portfolio.neutrality: Equal executed long/short dollars at rebalance; no claim of beta neutrality; actual gross exposure and between-rebalance drift reported

inference.primary: Calendar trading days, HAC Bartlett20 with small-sample correction, two-sided 95% CI and p
inference.multiplicity: All enumerated model/portfolio/window aggregate comparisons reported with Holm correction; seeds are diagnostics, never independent trading-day samples
inference.forecast_comparison: Paired daily IC difference between three-seed LiMT and LightGBM score ensembles on identical dates/stocks
inference.holdout_status: Newly constructed US transfer, but retrospective historical sample and contemporary method selection; not prospective validation
